notes: Layered necropolis rebuild for the opening Egypt Journey scene. The active art direction is warm semi-realistic Valley of the Kings cliffs crossed with Memphite Necropolis ruins, with only subtle corruption marks. The background is split into full-width scene strips for sky/light, far pyramids, distant cliffs, and mid necropolis ruins before the gameplay floor is drawn. These active scene layers must not be replaced by single-object cutout plates. The playable stone path is a dedicated world-locked route layer so Asha runs on the same visible route used by collision, enemies, shards, checkpoints, and gates. The ground backing layer is non-colliding visual support so the walkable floor reads as continuous land instead of a floating ledge.
groundLaneNote: Dedicated necropolis stone path layer. Drawn at parallax 1.0 (locked to the world / collision floor) so Asha runs on the same visible route that collision, enemies, shards, checkpoints, and gates use. Empty pixels outside the route can remain transparent, but painted route pixels must stay fully opaque.
coordinateNote: The active runtime uses layered PNGs. skyLight carries the warm sunset and base haze; farPyramids, distantCliffs, and midNecropolisRuins each draw at a different camera speed so the Egypt background has real depth instead of a single flat plate. groundBacking sits directly behind and under the gameplay floor as a visual-only sand body; groundLane scrolls at gameplay speed and remains the visible source of truth for the walkable floor. Future rebuilds should preserve this full-width parallax structure with a high quality Valley of the Kings plus Memphite Necropolis set that preserves the ravine bridge and pyramid climb route.
